customers_say: Customers find this smart lock to be of good quality, with a classy design that looks like a simple door handle. They appreciate its features, particularly the variety of access options and auto-lock functionality, while the face unlock feature works quickly and reliably. The lock receives positive feedback for its user-friendly app, top-notch installation, and build quality. While many customers consider it good value for money, some express dissatisfaction with the price.
